# transliteration scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transliterationScheme`](gmeow-transliterationScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transliterationScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/language`](../../slices/language.md)

The named transliteration/romanization system that produced an appellation's [`gmeow:romanization`](gmeow-romanization.md) (Hepburn vs Kunrei for Japanese; Pinyin vs Wade-Giles for Mandarin). Records HOW the romanization was derived. Non-functional. Domain [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) retrofits the names module; the scheme individuals are catalogued as FnO functions in the projection layer.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) -> [`gmeow:TransliterationScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TransliterationScheme.md)
